description.zh:
认证信息。 格式为：Bearer ${access_token}。 
> 请输入IDaaS签发的Access Token。
description.en:
The authentication information. The value must be in the `Bearer ${access_token}` format.

> The access token must be issued by IDaaS.
The ID of the IDaaS instance.

descriptions.zh:
该 API 基于 IDaaS 签发的 Access Token 进行身份认证和鉴权。

请确保传入的 Access Token 具备访问 IDaaS 内置 PAM 应用（Privileged Access Management）的“管理静态凭据”的功能授权。

> 对应的 scope 为 `urn:cloud:idaas:pam|credential:manage`。
descriptions.en:
This API operation uses an IDaaS-issued access token for authentication and authorization.

The access token must have the "Manage Static Credentials" permission for the built-in Privileged Access Management (PAM) application in IDaaS.

> The required scope is `urn:cloud:idaas:pam|credential:manage`.
